fact: The DIAL expert comment says Botswana's adequacy list of countries data may go to had only 2 African countries; it gives no date for the list, so the document's published date of 2026-06-15 is used.

Mmegi reports that the Data Protection Act, in effect since January 2025, allows data transfers abroad only to approved countries and requires a copy of the data to remain in Botswana; the report is dated 2025-11-25 and gives no other date for the statement.
